records.title: Nimbus Rest travel cot, model NR-220
records.hazard: Side rail can disengage under load, creating an entrapment gap
records.action: Stop using immediately and contact the retailer for a full refund

records.title: Calder & Vane 1.7L cordless kettle, CV-K17
records.hazard: Base connector overheats and can ignite surrounding material
records.action: Unplug and stop using; return to point of sale

records.title: Halvard Trail 24 children's bicycle helmet
records.hazard: Shell fails impact attenuation testing; inadequate head protection
records.action: Cease use; free replacement available from the importer

records.title: Sable Lumen USB-C wall charger, 65W
records.hazard: Insufficient insulation between primary and secondary circuits; electric shock risk
records.action: Stop using immediately; dispose of at an electrical waste facility

records.title: Marrow & Pike infant teething ring, assorted colours
records.hazard: Ring separates into small parts; choking hazard
records.action: Remove from the child immediately and return for a refund

records.title: Ferrow Works angle grinder, FW-AG115
records.hazard: Guard mounting can shear, exposing the rotating disc
records.action: Stop using; contact Ferrow Works for a repair kit

records.title: Orrin Fields convertible high chair, OF-HC3
records.hazard: Five-point restraint buckle can release without input
records.action: Stop using and request the free retrofit harness

records.title: Bracken Home oil-filled radiator, BH-OR1500
records.hazard: Thermal cutout fails to trip; enclosure reaches ignition temperature
records.action: Unplug and return for a full refund

records.title: Petrel Outdoor camping gas lantern, PL-90
records.hazard: Valve stem leaks fuel when the canister is inverted
records.action: Stop using; do not attempt to vent the canister indoors

records.title: Wexley wooden stacking toy set, 12 pieces
records.hazard: Painted rings detach into small parts; coating exceeds migration limits
records.action: Remove from children immediately and return for a refund

records.title: Dunmore Cycles rear child bike seat, DC-CS2
records.hazard: Mounting bracket cracks at the weld under normal cycling load
records.action: Stop using and contact the retailer for a replacement bracket

records.title: Iselin Kitchen 6L pressure cooker, IK-PC6
records.hazard: Lid interlock permits opening while the vessel is pressurised; scalding risk
records.action: Stop using immediately and return for a full refund
